answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore VQG from the perspective of 'guiding' a question generator... We introduced a guided approach to visual question generation (VQG).

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and MSJ as evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We ask seven humans across four experiments to evaluate the generative capabilities of our models.
answer_4.guideline: Humans were asked to (1) choose which of two questions was generated (visual Turing test), (2) judge grammatical naturalness, (3) assess relevance of the generated question to the image, and (4) verify if presented objects were relevant to the question.
criteria: ability to distinguish generated vs ground-truth question
